scheme_name: UGC Ishan Uday Special Scholarship for North Eastern Region (NER)
authority: University Grants Commission (UGC), Ministry of Education, Govt of India
jurisdiction: Central Scheme for North Eastern States (Disbursed via National Scholarship Portal)
benefit: ₹7,800/month for technical/medical/professional courses (₹78,000/yr) and ₹5,400/month for general courses

criteria.label: Permanent Domicile of North Eastern Region (NER)
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must possess a valid Permanent Resident / Domicile Certificate of one of the 8 North Eastern states (Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura).
criteria.source_clause: UGC Ishan Uday Guidelines Clause 2.1 - Target Group
criteria.remediation: Upload valid Domicile Certificate from competent state authority of NER.

criteria.label: Enrolled in 1st year of recognized General or Professional UG degree program
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must have passed Class 12 and enrolled in 1st year of general degree, technical, medical, or professional course.
criteria.source_clause: UGC Ishan Uday Guidelines Clause 2.2 - Qualifying Program
criteria.remediation: Upload bonafide admission letter from recognized college or university.

criteria.label: Annual family income ceiling (<= ₹4,50,000 per annum)
criteria.plain_description: Gross annual income of parents/family from all sources must not exceed ₹4.5 Lakh per annum.
criteria.source_clause: UGC Ishan Uday Guidelines Clause 2.3 - Income Limit
criteria.remediation: Upload valid Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar/Revenue Circle Officer.

criteria.label: Aadhaar verified and bank account linked
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must have Aadhaar seeded with their active bank account for DBT payment.
criteria.source_clause: UGC Payment Guidelines Clause 5 - DBT Modality
criteria.remediation: Upload Aadhaar card linked with bank account.

application.office_name: UGC North Eastern Regional Office (NERO) / College Nodal Officer
documents_to_carry: Domicile / Permanent Resident Certificate issued by District Magistrate/SDO
Income Certificate issued by designated Revenue Authority (<= ₹4.5 Lakh)
College Bonafide and 1st year Admission Fee receipt
Aadhaar Card and Bank Passbook copy
process_steps: Log in to National Scholarship Portal (NSP) using your OTR credentials
Apply under UGC Schemes: ISHAN UDAY SPECIAL SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME FOR NER
Enter Class 12 marks, college course details, and upload NER Domicile certificate
College verification through NSP college login
Monthly DBT stipend of up to ₹7,800/mo transferred via PFMS
